summary: An original 3v3 two-lane MOBA vertical slice: draft six original heroes, then lane, jungle, contest Catalysts/Colossus and break Seals to destroy the Crown Engine against server-side bots, with an authoritative 30 Hz worker simulation and fog-filtered snapshots.
notes: Fully offline: the 'server' is a Web Worker room in the page (same message protocol a WebSocket room would use); no human multiplayer, reconnect or real matchmaking backend. npm test takes ~100 s because it includes a full six-bot headless match. ?demo=<minutes> fast-forwards a bot-controlled match for screenshots.
